verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack mentions system snapshots, rollback, btrfs snapshots, or an equivalent recovery mechanism for failed updates; the evidence covers unrelated features (Boxes, containers, dark mode, app store) and general community sentiment. missing for 10: any mention of snapshot/rollback tooling (e.g. rpm-ostree deployments, Timeshift, btrfs snapshots), documentation of update rollback procedure, or user reports of successfully rolling back after a broken update.
